solutions.title: Sort and scan neighbors
solutions.strategy: Sort a copy of the input and check whether any adjacent values are equal.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting dominates the linear neighbor scan.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A copied array is sorted so the original input is not mutated.

solutions.title: Hash set membership
solutions.strategy: Track values that have already appeared and return true when the next value is already present.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value performs an expected constant-time set lookup and insertion.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The set can store every distinct value when there are no duplicates.
